syllabusSource.title: Pharmacy Council of India, Education Regulations 2020 (ER-2020), D.Pharm second year, Hospital and Clinical Pharmacy ER20-25T and ER20-25P (university copy of the PCI syllabus)

units.title: Hospital pharmacy – organisation, standards and accreditation
Committees in the hospital and the hospital formulary
Drug lists, purchase procedures and inventory control
Central drug store – storage, cold chain, expiry, disposal and documentation
Compounding in hospitals, IV admixtures and total parenteral nutrition
Radiopharmaceuticals and computers in hospital pharmacy
Clinical pharmacy – development, clinical terms and daily activities
Pharmaceutical care, drug-related problems, MTM and home medication review
Clinical laboratory tests – significance and interpretation
Poisoning, and drug and poison information centres
Pharmacovigilance, medication errors and drug interactions

practicals.title: Systematic approach to drug information queries
Interpretation of laboratory reports to optimise drug therapy
Filling the IPC ADR reporting form and causality assessment
Orthopaedic and surgical aids (knee cap, LS belt, abdominal belt, walker, walking sticks)
Types of bandages and dressing materials (gauze, cotton, crepe)
Needles, syringes, catheters, IV sets, urine bags, Ryle's tube, colostomy bags and oxygen masks
Wound dressing (simulated cases and role play)
Vaccination and injection techniques (IV, IM, SC) using mannequins
Use of hospital pharmacy software and digital health tools
